title: NexusCorp Remote Access Guide
content:
## Remote Access Steps

1. Download and install the SecureLink v2 client
2. Open SecureLink and click [Connect]
3. Enter server address: access.nexuscorp.io
4. Log in with your NexusCorp email and password
5. Select [Tunnel Mode] to connect

## Common Issues
- Connection timeout: Check network and firewall (port 443)
- Authentication failure: Reset password at https://pwd.nexuscorp.io
- Intranet access failed: Reconnect or call IT ext.7777

## Important Notes
- Password syncs with email, expires every 60 days
- Overseas travel requires special permission

title: New Hire Equipment Request
content:
## Request Process

1. OA System - Assets - Request Device
2. Fill form (manager approval required)
3. IT processes within 2 days
4. Pickup notification sent via email

## Standard Kit
- Laptop: Dell XPS 15 or MacBook Pro 14
- Monitor: LG 27-inch 4K
- Peripherals: Budget 600 CNY
- Phone: Based on role

## Notes
- Return equipment upon resignation
- Report damage immediately
- No unauthorized software

title: Remote Work Policy and Tools
content:
## Requirements

1. Connect via company VPN (see kb_001)
2. Stay active on NexusChat during hours
3. Daily standup at 09:30

## Tools
- Chat: NexusChat (mandatory), Slack (optional)
- Docs: Notion + Google Drive
- Code: GitHub Enterprise (VPN required)
- Meetings: Zoom (internal), Teams (external)

## Network
- Min bandwidth: 50Mbps down / 10Mbps up
- Stable connection required for video
- Hotspot subsidy available (150 CNY/mo)

## Security
- No public WiFi for sensitive work
- Auto-lock screen at 5 mins
- No recording meetings without consent

title: Time Off and Leave Rules
content:
## Entitlement
- 1 year: 5 days
- 3 years: 10 days
- 5 years: 15 days

## Process
1. OA System Request
2. Manager Approval
3. 3+ days needs Director approval

## Notes
- Request 3 days in advance
- Carryover max 5 days
- Sick leave needs medical cert

title: Account Security and MFA
content:
## Policy
- Min length: 14 characters
- Must include: Upper, Lower, Number, Symbol
- Validity: 60 days
- History: Last 6 passwords blocked

## Reset
1. Self-service: https://pwd.nexuscorp.io
2. NexusChat IT Bot
3. IT Hotline ext.7777

## MFA
- Mandatory for all systems
- App: NexusAuth recommended
- Backup: SMS code

## Lockout
- 5 fails = 30 min lock
- Self-unlock available or contact IT

title: Critical VPN Client Migration
content:
## Security Advisory

The IT Security Board has deprecated SecureLink v2 effective April 1, 2026.

**New Standard:**
Migrate to CloudGate v3 (Zscaler).

**Steps:**
1. Uninstall SecureLink
2. Download CloudGate from https://access.nexuscorp.io/dl
3. Login with same credentials

**Priority:** This notice overrides kb_001. Contact IT ext.7777 for help.

Note: kb_001 will be archived after migration.

title: Remote Connectivity Troubleshooting
content:
## Common Fixes

1. Check physical connection
2. Restart router
3. Verify VPN client status (see kb_003 for policy)
4. Flush DNS

## Performance
- High latency: Close background apps
- Packet loss: Switch to wired connection
- Video lag: Lower resolution in settings

## Escalation
- If steps fail, open ticket via OA
- Include screenshot of error
- Reference kb_003 for policy compliance
